content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 2 Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: TNPSC has announced a combined 821 vacancies for Group II Services (41 posts) and Group IIA Services (780 posts). The Commission has clarified that the number of vacancies notified is tentative and may be revised up to the publication of the preliminary examination result. The Group IIA "Assistant" and "Senior Revenue Inspector" posts carry district-wise and department-wise vacancy splits (for example, Assistant, Rural Development and Panchayat Raj is spread across all 32 districts; Assistant, Police has 45 posts; Assistant, School Education has 83 posts; Assistant, Highways has 50 posts). This district-wise and department-wise breakup runs across several pages of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 2 Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: TNPSC Group 2 eligibility 2026 is assessed as on the dates given in the notification - age is reckoned as on 01.07.2026, and educational qualification must be held on the date of notification (11.08.2026). Eligibility depends on nationality-neutral factors such as educational qualification, age limit, and (for a few posts) physical/medical standards, knowledge of Tamil, and community/gender-specific restrictions explained below. Candidates must possess adequate knowledge of Tamil as on the date of notification - either by having passed SSLC/HSC/Degree with Tamil as one of the languages, by having studied in Tamil medium, or by having passed the Second Class Language Test (Full Test) in Tamil conducted by TNPSC. Candidates not belonging to SC/SC(A)/ST/MBC/DC/BC(OBCM)/BCM who have completed five years or more of government service are not eligible, even if within the age limit. Only persons professing the Hindu religion are eligible for Audit Inspector (Post Code 1029), Executive Officer Grade III (Post Code 1654), and Assistant, HR&CE (Post Code 2271). Male candidates cannot apply for Jailor (Special Prison for Women) or Male Warden; female candidates cannot apply for Jailor (Men). Persons with colour blindness or night blindness are disqualified for Assistant Inspector (Post Code 1068) and Handloom Inspector (Post Code 1868). Persons with benchmark disabilities are not eligible for Jailor (Men), Jailor (Special Prison for Women), Special Assistant, and Special Branch Assistant (Post Codes 2279 and 3116).

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 2 Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on 01.07.2026 . The minimum and maximum age limits vary by post and by community category (Others vs. SC/SC(A)/ST/MBC/DC/BC(OBCM)/BCM), with additional age concessions for Persons with Benchmark Disability, Ex-servicemen, and Destitute Widows. Additional age relaxation is available for Persons with Benchmark Disability (up to 50 years / no maximum age limit depending on post) and Ex-servicemen (up to 42–55 years depending on post/qualification). No maximum age limit means the candidate should not have completed 60 years of age as on 01.07.2026. Exact post-wise figures are listed in Sections 4.1.1 and 4.1.2 of the official notification. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 2 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: TNPSC Group 2 selection process 2026 for both Group II and Group IIA Services consists of the following successive stages: Common Preliminary Examination: A single objective-type paper (screening test only); marks are not counted for final merit. Main Examination: Separate Main Examinations for Group II Services and Group IIA Services. Each Main Examination has two papers - Paper I (Tamil Eligibility Test, qualifying in nature) and Paper II (counted for ranking). Onscreen Certificate Verification: Based on Main Examination Paper II marks, candidates are admitted in the ratio of 1:3 (General category) and 1:2 (Reserved categories). Physical Certificate Verification and Counselling: Candidates are admitted in the ratio of 1:3 (General category) and 1:1.5 (Reserved categories), based on rank. Differently abled candidates may claim exemption from Paper I (Tamil Eligibility Test) of the Main Examination by furnishing the required details in the online application and uploading a Certificate of Disability.

faq.question: Q1. What is TNPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the Combined Civil Services Examination-II (Group II and IIA Services), Notification No. 07/2026, released by the Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission on 11.08.2026 to fill 821 vacancies in Group II (41 posts) and Group IIA (780 posts) Services.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TNPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 821 total vacancies - 41 in Group II Services and 780 in Group IIA Services, spread across multiple departments and districts in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TNPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 09.09.2026, 11:59 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for TNPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post - most posts require a degree from a UGC-recognised university, while a few posts (such as Assistant Section Officer, Law) require a B.L. degree or a specific postgraduate qualification. See the qualification table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for TNPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age is reckoned as on 01.07.2026. Minimum age is generally 18 years (up to 22 years for Probation Officer); maximum age is generally 32 years for "Others" category candidates, with no maximum age limit for SC/SC(A)/ST/MBC/DC/BC/BCM candidates for most posts, and further relaxation for Persons with Benchmark Disability, Ex-servicemen, and Destitute Widows.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for TNPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Preliminary Examination fee is Rs. 100/-. The Main Examination fee is Rs. 150/- (or Rs. 300/- if shortlisted for both Group II and Group IIA Main Examinations), payable only by candidates who have not claimed fee exemption.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for TNPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR) and then apply online through www.tnpscexams.in before 09.09.2026, following the step-by-step process explained in the "How to Apply" section above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TNPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Common Preliminary Examination (screening only), a Main Examination (separate for Group II and Group IIA, each with a qualifying Tamil Paper I and a ranking Paper II), Onscreen Certificate Verification, Physical Certificate Verification, and Counselling.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for TNPSC Group 2 posts?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the pay only as a "Level of Pay" (Level 9 to Level 18) in the Tamil Nadu pay matrix, depending on the post. Exact rupee figures are not specified in the notification.
